description_en: Lists all key-value pairs in a specified KV storage namespace under your account
description_zh: 列出账号下指定KV存储空间的所有键值对
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-kvs --namespace test_namespace --page-size 50 --page-number 10 --prefix prefix- --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListKvs

parameters.help_en: The name specified when you called https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850317.html
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: **50**. Maximum value: **100**
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回的页大小。默认：**50**，最大：**100**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The product of PageNumber and PageSize cannot exceed 50000
parameters.help_zh: 指定页码，PageNumber*PageSize最大不可超过50000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The prefix used to filter keys
parameters.name: prefix
